heading: Principal office
lead: The principal office of the foundation shall be in the District of Columbia unless the board of directors determines otherwise. However, the foundation may conduct business throughout the States, territories, and possessions of the United States.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2014—Pub. L. 113–237 renumbered section 152606 of this title as this section.
